f_road.title: Draw a road from the Founding Stake
f_road.hint: Roads tab, then drag a Dirt Track. Everything grows beside a road.

f_hearth.title: Zone hearths beside the road
f_hearth.hint: Zones tab, Hearth, drag a rectangle touching the road.

f_jobs.title: Zone Craft works and a Market
f_jobs.hint: Folk need jobs; markets need goods from the works.

f_spire.title: Raise a Ley Spire within 6 tiles of the node
f_spire.hint: Ley tab. A lit spire lights 5 tiles; lit buildings light their neighbours.

f_well.title: Dig a Well
f_well.hint: Water tab. Wells water 8 tiles, more near the river.

f_watch.title: Build a Watch Post and a Shrine of Aume
f_watch.hint: Services tab. The Watch calms unrest; the shrine lifts hearts.

f_sector.title: Extend the Charter
f_sector.hint: Click the dimmed land beyond the Charter line: from Hamlet a touching sector can be bought, and the Gloam inside draws back.

f_hamlet.title: Reach 40 folk: a Hamlet
f_hamlet.hint: Keep zoning where the demand bars are high.

l_nexus.title: Build a Ley Nexus
l_nexus.hint: Stores 120 mana to soak up peaks before they become surges.

d_boneyard.title: Build a Boneyard before the dead rise
d_boneyard.hint: Unquieted dead become the restless. Services tab.

g_ward.title: Raise a Ward Lantern
g_ward.hint: Burns back the Gloam within 10 tiles. Needs mana.

o_depot.title: Build a Trade Depot
o_depot.hint: Sells surplus goods at seasonal prices on the Gloam road.

a_academy.title: Educate a third of the folk
a_academy.hint: An Academy of the Ley schools within 14 tiles.

x_charter.title: Charter a district
x_charter.hint: Edicts panel: pick the district in Scope and choose a charter. A Craft quarter makes a fifth more goods; a Hearth quarter is worth more to live in; each has a price.

c_thorp.title: Become a Thorp (100 folk)
c_thorp.hint: Zone, light, water; keep taxes near 10%.

c_village.title: Become a Village (220 folk)
c_village.hint: Healers and a Boneyard keep folk alive and quiet.

c_market.title: Become a Market Town (650 folk)
c_market.hint: Markets need goods; carts need roads.

c_burgh.title: Become a Burgh (1000 folk)
c_burgh.hint: Watch the mana; a Nexus and Fonts carry a burgh.

c_free.title: Become a Free City (1500 folk)
c_free.hint: Deepen the Wellspring; districts and edicts keep the peace.

c_beacon.title: Become a Beacon of Eda (2200 folk)
c_beacon.hint: Reach 2200 folk and the happiness gate (the top bar names it), and raise and light the Lantern of Vell.
